youtube.baslik: Why are low pitches turned down when measuring noise? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: The human ear is less sensitive to low pitches, especially at moderate levels, and A-weighting filters measured sound to resemble this sensitivity. The A filter is zero at 1000 Hz and cuts about 16 dB at 125 Hz; occupational exposure is measured A-weighted, while peak sound pressure is measured C-weighted.
